svg.text: Offline-first Android app · deterministic rules engine · AI only for language · privacy by design
EKKO ANDROID APP · Flutter 3.35 · Dart · runs fully offline
AppState: session · language · journey (profile → bundle → quote → KYC)
Domain engines — pure Dart, deterministic, unit-tested (46 tests)
Bundle repair loop: substitute · auto-add · block
Quote: setup = Σ setup×qty · contract = max term
Auth: OTP · lock-out · salted phone hash
nothing leaves the phone by default
app key · per-IP rate limit · masked logs
receives free text & plan summary only —
